pages.title: Pattern Basin
pages.text: A shallow dish of two chemicals: one makes more of itself, the other holds it back, and between them stripes appear.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 3$() machine.
$(thing)Made on the Extreme Assembly Table$() (it is also a crafting table). The recipe pages at the end of this entry - and JEI - show the pattern.

Set the spreading ratio r and the reaction rate k. Below r of about 5.8 nothing forms. Above it the pattern's spacing is about 2π·r^¼/√k, which must be inside the recipe's window. A faster reaction is quicker, but needs a larger ratio for the same spacing.
$(thing)Machine data$(): a single-block machine (5 item and 1 fluid inputs, 1 and 0 outputs).$(br2)$(thing)Makes$(): Network Map, Pattern Template, Turing Morphogen.
